result.instructions: Potencia Dashboard Leads MCP. Call list_projects or create_project to manage workspaces. Use list_leads, get_lead, find_lead_by_email, create_lead, update_lead, or delete_lead to track leads. Use log_approach, list_lead_logs, and delete_lead_log to manage outreach interactions. Use leads_report to compute outbound conversion and pipeline analytics.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all registered dashboard projects with their slugs, names, taglines, and board IDs.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new dashboard project workspace with an automatic default Kanban board.

slug.description: Optional unique project slug. Defaults to slugified name.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: List outbound leads with optional filtering by project slug, status, text search, and limit.

search.description: Case-insensitive text search in name, company, email, website, or role.

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return (1..500, default 100).

tools.name: get_lead
tools.description: Retrieve full details of a single lead by its ID, including its chronological outreach logs.

tools.name: find_lead_by_email
tools.description: Find leads matching an email address (case-insensitive, trimmed). Optionally scoped to a single project.

projectSlug.description: Optional project slug to restrict match to a single project.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Add a new outbound lead to a project board. Supports email deduplication and optional initial outreach approach.

projectSlug.description: Project slug (required, must exist in registry).

name.description: Lead full name or contact name.

status.description: Initial lead status. Defaults to 'new' (or derived if initialApproach provided).

nextFollowUpAt.description: Next follow-up timestamp (ISO 8601 string or epoch ms).

initialApproach.description: Optional initial outreach touch logged immediately upon creation.

approachedAt.description: Timestamp of initial contact (ISO string or ms, defaults to now).

onDuplicate.description: Behavior if a lead with the same email already exists in the project: 'return_existing' or 'error'.

tools.name: update_lead
tools.description: Update metadata, status, or timestamps of an existing lead. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

leadId.description: ID of the lead to update.

nextFollowUpAt.description: Next follow-up timestamp (ISO string, epoch ms, or null to clear).

lastContactedAt.description: Last contacted timestamp (ISO string, epoch ms, or null to clear).

tools.name: delete_lead
tools.description: Delete a lead and all associated outreach logs.

leadId.description: ID of the lead to delete.

tools.name: log_approach
tools.description: Record an outreach touch (email, LinkedIn, cold call, WhatsApp, etc.) with automatic status progression.

approachedAt.description: Timestamp of outreach touch (ISO string or epoch ms, defaults to now).

nextFollowUpAt.description: Optional scheduled next follow-up timestamp (ISO string or ms).

autoUpdateStatus.description: Whether to derive and advance lead status from outcome (default true).

explicitStatus.description: Explicitly override lead status regardless of derived outcome.

tools.name: list_lead_logs
tools.description: Retrieve the complete outreach interaction log history for a specific lead in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: delete_lead_log
tools.description: Delete an outreach log entry from a lead and recalculate the lead's last_contacted_at timestamp.

logId.description: ID of the outreach log entry to remove.

tools.name: leads_report
tools.description: Compute real-time outbound funnel metrics, stage counts, reply/conversion rates, and follow-up queues.

projectSlug.description: Filter report to a specific project slug (omit for all projects).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List available Kanban projects (by projectSlug) along with their status columns.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new dashboard project and its default Kanban board columns.

slug.description: Optional unique project slug. Defaults to slugified name.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Retrieve Kanban tasks for a project. Supports filtering by status (column name like 'To do' / 'In Progress' or columnId), priority, and text search.

status.description: Filter by status column name (e.g. 'Backlog', 'To do', 'In Progress', 'Review', 'Done') or columnId.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against title or description.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of tasks to return.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Retrieve full details of a single Kanban task by its cardId.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new Kanban task card on a project board. Defaults to the 'To do' column and 'medium' priority.

status.description: Target status column name (e.g. 'Backlog', 'To do', 'In Progress', 'Review', 'Done') or columnId. Defaults to 'To do'.

position.description: Insert at 'top' or 'bottom' of the target column. Defaults to 'bottom'.

tools.name: change_task_status
tools.description: Move a Kanban task to a different status column (e.g. 'Backlog', 'To do', 'In Progress', 'Review', 'Done') and optionally position it.

status.description: Destination status column name (e.g. 'In Progress', 'Done') or columnId.

position.description: Optional destination position ('top', 'bottom', or 0-based index). Defaults to 'bottom'.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a Kanban task's title, description, priority, and/or status column. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

status.description: New status column name or columnId.
